opening: I have a spot on my lower lip.
I smoke a pack of cigarettes a day, and have for the last 20 years.

opening.text: I've got a spot on my lower lip that's been there for three months. I smoke a pack a day and have for the last 20 years. I'm a fruit picker, which I've done for 25 years, and my work is outdoors.
